issue_context.title: Inconsistent behaviour of position function with mysql
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Mysql's position function is case insensitive while the tidb is case sensitive.

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

mysql:

create table if not exists test.test_tb(id int NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id));

insert into test_tb (id) values (1);

select position('a' in 'AA') from test_tb;

tidb:

create table if not exists test.test_tb(id int NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id));

insert into test_tb (id) values (1);

select position('a' in 'AA') from test_tb;

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

tidb output:

+-----------------------+
| position('a' in 'AA') |   |
+-----------------------+
|                     1             |
+-----------------------+

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

tidb output:

+-----------------------+
| position('a' in 'AA') |   |
+-----------------------+
|                     0             |
+-----------------------+

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

git hash: 8e0b5706d5549

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->

all collation results should be same with bin collation while set new collation false.
```sql
mysql> set names utf8mb4 collate utf8mb4_general_ci ;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

mysql> select position('a' in "AA");
+-----------------------+
| position('a' in "AA") |
+-----------------------+
|                     1 |
+-----------------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

mysql> select * from mysql.tidb;
+-----------------------+----------------+----------------------------------------------------+
| VARIABLE_NAME         | VARIABLE_VALUE | COMMENT                                            |
+-----------------------+----------------+----------------------------------------------------+
| bootstrapped          | True           | Bootstrap flag. Do not delete.                     |
| tidb_server_version   | 72             | Bootstrap version. Do not delete.                  |
| system_tz             | Asia/Shanghai  | TiDB Global System Timezone.                       |
| new_collation_enabled | False          | If the new collations are enabled. Do not edit it. |
+-----------------------+----------------+----------------------------------------------------+
4 rows in set (0.01 sec)

mysql>  set names utf8mb4 collate utf8mb4_bin;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

mysql> select position('a' in "AA");
+-----------------------+
| position('a' in "AA") |
+-----------------------+
|                     0 |
+-----------------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)
```
